items.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
items.summary: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
items.summary: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

items.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
items.summary: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

items.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
items.summary: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

items.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
items.summary: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

items.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
items.summary: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.
